ai.overview: The Washington Commanders bring the Belt Holders lineal championship to Arizona on November 29, 2026, having defended it once in their current reign. The Cardinals, struggling through a three-game losing streak, will look to claim the belt for the 25th time in franchise history when they host Washington at home.
key_matchups: Washington's recent form: winners of their last 2 games including a 22–20 squeaker over Cincinnati versus Arizona's freefall with 3 straight losses
Recent history heavily favors Washington: the Commanders won 42-14 in their last meeting in 2024 and have won 3 of the last 5 head-to-head contests
Arizona's offensive struggles: the Cardinals scored just 7, 6, and 3 points in their last three games respectively
ai.betting_angles: The Commanders hold a commanding 78-47-2 all-time edge in this series and dominated the most recent meeting 42-14. Arizona's recent offensive output of 7, 6, and 3 points across their three-game skid stands in stark contrast to Washington's ability to win close games.
ai.prediction_writeup: The Commanders have found a way to win tight games, taking their last two by margins of 2 and 3 points, while Arizona has been overwhelmed in recent weeks. Washington's 4-5-1 record is deceptive given their recent form, and they crushed these same Cardinals 42-14 in 2024. Arizona's inability to score—managing just 7, 6, and 3 points in their last three outings—suggests the offensive struggles will continue against a Washington side that our Elo model favors. The Commanders retain the belt on the road.
